## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow the [Angular convention](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commits) (`type(scope): subject`) — CI enforces this
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] Documentation updated if the public API changed
